context_visible: Aerial view of a rural landscape featuring a cluster of multi-story residential buildings with tiled roofs and solar panels on the left.
Large rectangular plots of green crops in the upper right.
A dirt road separates the residential area from a large agricultural zone in the foreground.
The foreground zone contains numerous long, parallel plastic-covered tunnels (greenhouses) and a strip of tilled soil.
A blue-roofed structure is visible in the distance near the green fields.
cross_view_relations: The second image is a zoomed-in view of the agricultural zone in the lower right of the first image.
The white and black tunnel structures visible in the first image are shown in detail in the second image.
The dirt path separating the greenhouses is clearly visible in both views.
The row of trees along the road in the first image corresponds to the vegetation seen in the background of the second image.
perception.description: The images show a rural area with houses and green fields. The foreground features a large agricultural site with rows of plastic-covered greenhouses and a dirt access road. The second image provides a closer view of these tunnels, revealing their white and black coverings and the surrounding vegetation.
evidence_visible: Close-up of the plastic-covered tunnels seen in the context image.
Tunnels are arranged in parallel rows with a dirt path running between them.
Some tunnels have white plastic covers, while others appear to have black or dark-colored covers.
Green vegetation is visible inside the open ends of some tunnels.
Small white objects, possibly weights or anchors, are visible along the edges of the plastic sheets.
unclear: The specific type of crop being grown inside the tunnels.
The exact dimensions of the structures.
The purpose of the white objects along the edges.
The condition of the plastic covers (e.g., age, damage).
